Trump's UN Address Contains False and Misleading Claims, Reports Say

President Donald Trump made numerous false and misleading claims during his address to the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday. Reports indicate these claims, many of which he has repeated previously, were scrutinized for accuracy regarding oil, drug seizures, and military statements. One report highlighted Israel's release of an exposé on UN bias preceding the General Assembly.
